newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends lower, March sharply down.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends lower, March sharply down.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed lower with near March showing the sharpest decline on selling by both a recent deliverer and a recent stopper, floor sources said.
They noted Atwood Commodities, the major deliverer this week, was a featured seller along with Country Hedging, the key stopper.
"Atwood kept putting out wheat and the stopper is now trying to sell the March," one floor source said.
March ended off 17-1/2 cents at $4.10-1/2 a bushel. Volume on the spot contract was reported to be light.
The key May contract was weakened by continued hedge selling although mill-related buying helped to limit losses. May ended off 3-1/4 cents at $3.97-1/2.
Floor sources said solid overhead resistance around $4.02 a bushel in May continued to limit the upside potential.
"We are stalling every time we get near there," one dealer said. The day's high for May was $4.00-1/2.
Other months finished off one to 4-1/2 cents.
